006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.InvalidTreatTypeDynamicMetapathException;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.cst.path.Axis;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.IDocumentBasedNodeItem;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.IDocumentNodeItem;
013import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.INodeItem;
014import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.InvalidTypeMetapathException;
015import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.TypeMetapathException;
016import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
017
018import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
019import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
020
021/**
022 * Provides a variety of utilities for working with Metapath items.
023 */
024public final class ItemUtils {
025
026  private ItemUtils() {
027    // disable construction
028  }
029
030  /**
031   * Checks that the item is an {@link INodeItem}.
032   *
033   * @param dynamicContext
034   *          the dynamic evaluation context
035   * @param item
036   *          the item to check
037   * @return the item cast to a {@link INodeItem}
038   * @throws TypeMetapathException
039   *           if the item is {@code null} or not an {@link INodeItem}
040   */
041  // FIXME: make this a method on the type implementation
042  @NonNull
043  public static INodeItem checkItemIsNodeItem(
044      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
045      @Nullable IItem item) {
046    return checkItemIsType(dynamicContext, item, INodeItem.class);
047  }
048
049  /**
050   * Checks that the item is an {@link IDocumentNodeItem}.
051   *
052   * @param dynamicContext
053   *          the dynamic evaluation context
054   * @param item
055   *          the item to check
056   * @return the item cast to a {@link INodeItem}
057   * @throws TypeMetapathException
058   *           if the item is {@code null} or not an {@link INodeItem}
059   */
060  @NonNull
061  public static IDocumentBasedNodeItem checkItemIsDocumentNodeItem(
062      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
063      @Nullable IItem item) {
064    return checkItemIsType(dynamicContext, item, IDocumentBasedNodeItem.class);
065  }
066
067  @NonNull
068  private static <T extends IItem> T checkItemIsType(
069      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
070      @Nullable IItem item,
071      @NonNull Class<T> itemClass) {
072    if (itemClass.isInstance(item)) {
073      return ObjectUtils.notNull(itemClass.cast(item));
074    }
075    if (item == null) {
076      throw new TypeMetapathException(TypeMetapathException.NOT_A_NODE_ITEM_FOR_STEP, "Item is null.")
077          .registerEvaluationContext(dynamicContext);
078    }
079    throw new TypeMetapathException(
080        TypeMetapathException.NOT_A_NODE_ITEM_FOR_STEP,
081        String.format("The item of type '%s' is not of the type '%s'.",
082            item.getClass().getName(),
083            itemClass.getName()))
084                .registerEvaluationContext(dynamicContext);
085  }
086
087  /**
088   * Get the ancestor document nodes for the provided items.
089   * <p>
090   * The resulting sequence has items of the {@link IDocumentBasedNodeItem} to
091   * allow for both module and document querying.
092   *
093   * @param dynamicContext
094   *          the dynamic evaluation context
095   * @param items
096   *          the node items to get the document roots for
097   * @return the document root node items
098   */
099  @NonNull
100  public static ISequence<IDocumentBasedNodeItem> getDocumentNodeItems(
101      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
102      @NonNull ISequence<?> items) {
103    return ISequence.of(ObjectUtils.notNull(items.stream()
104        // ensures a non-null INodeItem instance
105        .map(item -> checkItemIsNodeItem(dynamicContext, item))
106        .map(item -> Axis.ANCESTOR_OR_SELF.execute(ObjectUtils.notNull(item))
107            .findFirst().stream()
108            .filter(IDocumentBasedNodeItem.class::isInstance)
109            .map(firstItem -> checkItemIsDocumentNodeItem(dynamicContext, firstItem))
110            .findFirst().orElseThrow(() -> new InvalidTreatTypeDynamicMetapathException(
111                dynamicContext.getExecutionStack(),
112                String.format("The node '%s' is not the descendant of a document node.",
113                    item.getMetapath()))))));
114  }
115
116  /**
117   * Check that the item is the type specified by {@code clazz}.
118   *
119   * @param <TYPE>
120   *          the Java type the item is required to match
121   * @param item
122   *          the item to check
123   * @param clazz
124   *          the Java class to check the item against
125   * @return the item cast to the required class value
126   * @throws TypeMetapathException
127   *           if the item is {@code null} or does not match the type specified by
128   *           {@code clazz}
129   */
130  // FIXME: make this a method on the type implementation
131  @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
132  @NonNull
133  public static <TYPE> TYPE checkItemType(@NonNull IItem item, @NonNull Class<TYPE> clazz) {
134    if (clazz.isInstance(item)) {
135      return (TYPE) item;
136    }
137    throw new InvalidTypeMetapathException(
138        item,
139        String.format(
140            "The item of type '%s' is not the required type '%s'.",
141            item.getClass().getName(),
142            clazz.getName()));
143  }
144}
